title: Saltreach Fen - Reedwalk Lull
_note: Option A anchor. gbc 4-voice band. D natural minor slow marsh wander. Breathy long-held pulse25 lead leaving rests for the water; pulse12 rocking root-fifth water-lap; tri_bass gentle rocking root-fifth sway; very sparse drums. Vesper spine in minor: lift A3->D4->E4, settle F4->E4->D4 sagging a half-step longer. 24-bar loop, last bar voice-leads back to bar 1.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: A: full Vesper lift+settle (the spine). A': repeat. B: questioning lift to G, the homesick turn. A'': settle that voice-leads home. Long notes + rests = water answers.
